purpose: Turn Flyway indicators into an evidenced database-migration workflow Skill rather than a technology-named Skill.

evidence.fact: The Maven build declares Flyway and a database-migration profile.
evidence.observation: flyway-core and flyway-maven-plugin are declared and profile id is database-migration
evidence.whyItMatters: The build indicator seeds a focused search for a repository migration procedure.

evidence.fact: The repository contains a published V1 migration.
evidence.whyItMatters: Existing versioned migrations make naming and published-history protection relevant.

evidence.fact: The repository contains a published V2 migration.
evidence.observation: V2__add_order_status.sql adds the order status column
evidence.whyItMatters: Multiple immutable migrations show a repeated append-only workflow.

evidence.fact: The migration runbook declares create, migrate, and validate steps.
evidence.observation: workflow is add a new V<next>__description.sql file, then run mvn -Pdatabase-migration flyway:migrate && mvn -Pdatabase-migration flyway:validate
evidence.whyItMatters: Migration changes have a project-specific sequence and exact completion check.

skillDecisions.name: database-migration
skillDecisions.reason: Published migrations and the project runbook establish a repeated, error-sensitive migration workflow with exact validation.

queries: Flyway migration naming published history migrate validate workflow
targetedFollowUpSearch.result: Found an append-only migration history plus documented creation, migrate, and validate steps.

taskTriggers: adding or validating a database schema migration
whenNotToUse: changing application code without a schema migration
workflowSteps: Read the migration runbook and inspect the highest published migration version.
Add a new V<next>__description.sql file without editing published migrations.
Run the documented migrate step before the validate completion check.
